title: Facebook Ads Library Input
description: Pull live and inactive ads from Meta's public Ads Library by keyword or advertiser page. No login. No cookies. Pay per ad row.

queries.title: Search keywords
queries.description: Keywords to search across the Ads Library. Each query runs as one Ads Library search per country. Examples: 'smart mattress', 'meal kit', 'crm software'.

pageUrls.title: Advertiser page URLs or IDs
pageUrls.description: Pull every ad currently and recently run by these advertisers. Accepts full Facebook page URLs (e.g. 'https://www.facebook.com/Nike'), Ads Library deeplinks with view_all_page_id, or raw numeric page IDs.

countries.title: Countries
countries.description: ISO country codes to scope each search to. The Ads Library is country-scoped at the request level. Default ['US'].

adType.title: Ad type
adType.description: Filter by ad category. ALL covers commercial ads. POLITICAL_AND_ISSUE_ADS surfaces the political archive with funder and spend ranges.

activeStatus.title: Active status
activeStatus.description: Whether to include only currently running ads, only inactive, or both.

maxAdsPerQuery.title: Max ads per query
maxAdsPerQuery.description: Stop scrolling for a given query/page once this many ad rows have been collected. Higher numbers add latency, proxy cost, and detection risk.

concurrency.title: Concurrency
concurrency.description: Number of Ads Library searches processed in parallel. Three is a safe default given Meta anti-bot.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify proxy. Residential is required for the Ads Library at any meaningful volume.
